snippet.title: Chrono Odyssey | Gameplay Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Join the Closed Beta for Chrono Odyssey on June 20th

In this closed beta gameplay walkthrough, step into the role of a Sentinel, wielder of the mysterious Chronotector. Travel through fragmented timelines, master powerful combat mechanics, and confront the Void threatening all existence.

#chronoodyssey #closedbeta
